audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows read Lucian or Skill while the whys[] under them say the opposite — whys[2] 'she hits her spike', whys[3] 'out-trade you now', whys[5] 'first item swings to her', whys[1]/[4]/[6] all say 'even'.
audit.why: Packet chart: Lucian, Skill, Illaoi, Illaoi, Skill, Illaoi, Skill. The mirror already flipped levels 3, 4-5, 6, First item and 2+ items to Illaoi on its side and called this the worst chart in the slice.
audit.corrected: win[1..6] flipped with their phases[N].side partners as one atomic group, ratings moved to match, and phases[1..6].why rewritten to state the reason for the side now shown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Test of Spirit is the tracked cooldown on every field with no number, and Harsh Lesson is never given a timer at all.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s at 900 range. Harsh Lesson is a FOUR second cooldown and an auto-attack reset — her leap is effectively always available, which is why 'trade on her cooldown' fails here if the reader only counts the E.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, spikes[1].text, early and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to run once Test of Spirit lands, and twice claims 'a missed cleanse heals her to full'.
audit.why: Riot's text: if the spirit is KILLED, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target becomes a Vessel and starts spawning Tentacles. So running from your own spirit is the losing play — it is the exact thing that turns you into a Vessel. Separately, nothing in the kit file establishes whether Test of Spirit is cleansable, so the 'missed cleanse' framing is an assertion the data does not support and is removed rather than reversed.
audit.corrected: The Vessel condition written into report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns, whys[2], spikes[1].text and early; the cleanse claim dropped.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' with no stated mechanism.
audit.why: Prophet of an Elder God heals Illaoi whenever her Tentacles damage a champion. That is the sustain, and it means the heal scales with how long you stand next to tentacles, not with her item build.
audit.corrected: The reason written into mid so the Grievous Wounds buy is tied to standing in the tentacle field.

edits.before: She hits her spike: E rips your spirit, her slams shred you while you run, and a missed cleanse heals her to full.
edits.after: Her spike: Test of Spirit rips your spirit, and walking away from it turns you into a Vessel spawning her tentacles.

edits.before: Illaoi's E (Test of Spirit) is her real spike — if she rips your spirit you must run from your own slammed tentacles or she heals to full.
edits.after: Test of Spirit (16s) is her real spike — do not run from your spirit: leaving it or letting it die makes you a Vessel that spawns tentacles.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are yours: your auto range out-ranges her and the Lightslinger double-tap off your first Q chunks her before a single tentacle is on the map. Poke with Q and back off — do not stand still. The instant she hits Level 3 her E (Test of Spirit) is the whole lane: if it tethers you, your spirit spawns and her tentacles slam you while you run, and missing the cleanse heals her to full. Treat that skillshot like a death sentence and pre-move sideways through it.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours: your auto range beats hers and the Lightslinger double-tap off your first Q chunks her before a single tentacle is on the map. Poke with Q and back off — do not stand still. The instant she hits 3, Test of Spirit (16s at rank 1, 900 range) is the whole lane: if it rips your spirit, do NOT sprint away — leaving the spirit or letting it die turns you into a Vessel that spawns her tentacles. Pre-move sideways through the skillshot instead.

edits.before: From Level 3 on the lane flips. She has more tentacles, more sustain, and her W slam plus E flip can lock you for the half-second her slams need. Never trade beside a tentacle — they hit hard and stack. Use W's move-speed mark and E (Relentless Pursuit) purely to dodge her E and kite, not to dive in. At 6 her R grows a ring of tentacles; stay outside the field, poke the tentacles down with Q, and never channel The Culling where her slams can interrupt you.
edits.after: From Level 3 on the lane flips. She has more tentacles, more sustain, and Harsh Lesson is a four-second auto reset, so her leap comes far more often than you plan for. Never trade beside a tentacle — every tentacle that damages you heals her, which is what your Grievous Wounds is for. Use the Ardent Blaze mark and Relentless Pursuit purely to dodge Test of Spirit and kite, never to dive. At 6 her R grows a tentacle per champion hit; chip them from outside.

notes: Two flags on Illaoi's R in the kit file — 'grounding' and 'untargetable' — contradict Riot's own description of Leap of Faith, which only deals damage and spawns a tentacle per champion hit. The _missing file's 'Illaoi can go untargetable through your commit' headline is derived from that bad flag, so I did not write it. Per the brief's rule I trusted the description. The substantive fix is the Vessel condition: the page told the reader to run from the spirit, which is precisely how you become a Vessel. Chart was six-of-seven wrong against its own prose; flipped as one atomic group.
